metadataRaw.title: One Move to Quickly Realign Your Spine
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a quick and effective stretch to help release tight back muscles that might be pulling your spine out of alignment—especially if you’re feeling tilted, crooked, or leaning to one side.

No equipment is needed, and it can be done at home. You may see results in as little as 30 seconds.

Give it a try and let us know how it works for you!
